4	
5	The full TERPSICHORE-style stability workflow is a chain:
6	
7	```text
8	equilibrium and profiles

11	    -> interval energy

14	
15	This task focuses on a specific scientific expansion of that chain:
16	
17	> the system must handle a ladder of boundary regimes, not only a simpler
18	> baseline boundary setting.
19	
20	In constrained boundary settings, edge displacement is constrained more strongly
21	than core displacement. In this reduced model, that idea is represented by an
22	interval-wise boundary-response profile and a matching assembly-time boundary
23	closure profile.

1	# Agent-Visible Method Context
2	
3	This task uses a reduced, self-contained snapshot of a DESC-native migration of
4	TERPSICHORE-style ideal MHD stability calculations. The public materials are
5	method notes rather than a single article excerpt because the capability being
6	tested is the reconstruction of a scientific workflow, not the correction of a
7	single equation typo.
8
